sections.title: Tax on business income of Offshore Banking Units or International Financial Services Centre unit.
sections.text_before_subsections: Where the total income of an assessee includes income of the nature referred to in section 147(3), the aggregate of income-tax payable by the assessee shall be the aggregate of income-tax computed on the income specified in column B of the Table below at the rate specified in the corresponding entry in column C of the said Table:

rows.income: Total income as reduced by income referred to in Sl. No. (1)
